about: Hand-labelled claims for the verify_claim judge. Small set written by the developer from the two bundled course texts, not a benchmark. expected: supported = the passages state it; contradicted = the passages state the opposite or the correct fact; not_in_material = the passages do not settle it (some of these are true in the world but absent from the notes).

course_transformers_w4.claim: Self-attention builds a contextual vector for each word as a weighted average of the value vectors.
Without positional information a Transformer cannot tell which token came first.
The attention score between two tokens is the dot product of a query and a key, scaled by the square root of the key dimension.
Two tokens can have similar keys but carry different values.
Multi-head attention runs the attention computation several times in parallel, each in a smaller subspace.
One attention head produces a single weighted average, which limits what it can express.
Backpropagation computes the gradients and gradient descent uses them to update the weights.
Value iteration applies the Bellman optimality update directly instead of running a separate evaluation step.
Positional encodings can be fixed sinusoidal patterns or learned vectors.
Attention weights already encode which words are important, so positional information only adds cosmetic order detail.
Backpropagation is the same thing as gradient descent.
If you remove positional encodings the model loses track of which words matter most.
Backprop is the step that decides how far to move each weight.
The learning rate is part of how the gradient itself is calculated.
Policy improvement and value iteration are the same thing.
Self-attention on its own is sensitive to the order of the tokens.
Multi-head attention runs a single head over the input.
In self-attention each token only compares itself with the token right before it.
The attention score between two tokens is the sum of the query and the key.
Queries carry the content that gets passed forward, and values are what a token is looking for.
Value iteration first runs a full policy evaluation and then improves the policy.
Each attention head in multi-head attention attends to the whole model dimension with no smaller subspace.
Transformers apply layer normalisation after each sublayer.
The original Transformer used six encoder layers.
Adam adapts the learning rate separately for each parameter.
Language models are usually trained with a cross-entropy loss.

course_probability.claim: Conditioning shrinks the sample space to the outcomes where the given event happened and then renormalises.
P of A given B and P of B given A answer different questions and are usually not equal.
Two events are independent when learning that one happened does not change the probability of the other.
Two draws from a deck without replacement are not independent.
Mutually exclusive events that both have positive probability are dependent.
In Bayes theorem the denominator is the total probability of the evidence, and it normalises the posterior.
A positive test for a rare disease can still leave the chance of disease low because the prior is small.
Expected value is the probability-weighted average of the possible outcomes.
A fair die has an expected value of 3.5 even though no single roll equals 3.5.
In the Monty Hall problem, switching doors wins with probability two thirds.
P(A|B) and P(B|A) are the same thing, so the order of the bar does not matter.
Mutually exclusive events are independent.
After the host opens a goat door, the two unopened doors are equally likely, so switching does not matter.
The chance of a positive test given the disease is the same as the chance of the disease given a positive test.
If two events cannot happen together, learning that one occurred tells you nothing about the other.
In Monty Hall the host opens a random door, so the prize splits evenly between the two remaining doors.
If a test is 99 percent accurate, a positive result means about a 99 percent chance you have the disease.
Expected value tells you the single most likely outcome of a gamble.
Expected value measures how risky a gamble is.
Conditioning on B means adding the outcomes outside B to the sample space.
Two draws from a deck without replacement are independent because every card is equally likely.
The prior is the updated belief after seeing the evidence, and the posterior is what we believed beforehand.
With one hundred doors, after the host opens ninety-eight goat doors the chance the remaining door hides the prize is one percent.
A gamble is fair when its expected value is greater than what you pay to play.
The central limit theorem says that sample means become approximately normal.
The variance of a fair six-sided die roll is about 2.92.
The Poisson distribution models counts of rare events.
Thomas Bayes never published his theorem during his lifetime.
